title: Steve Jobs: "Just avoid holding it that way"
caption:
The most beautiful phone of 2010 had one flaw: your hand. 📵
The steel band was the antenna, split by tiny gaps; bridge the bottom-left gap with your skin and the signal dropped.
Would you have taken the free bumper or held it 'wrong' anyway?
sources: Apple press conference, 16 July 2010 (free bumper cases for iPhone 4 owners)
Widely reported email reply from Steve Jobs, June 2010: "Just avoid holding it in that way."
